items.title: Anthropic's mid-tier Claude climbs the rankings
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5.5, a 30% faster mid-tier model scoring 56 on AA's Intelligence Index—surpassing GPT-6 Astra's 53 and nearing Opus performance at roughly half the cost. The model delivers significant coding improvements rivaling Opus and introduced the first Sonnet-tier cybersecurity guardrails. The release raises the bar ahead of OpenAI's DevDay.

items.title: Show HN: Reflex Engine Beats Both Llama.cpp and vLLM on Cold-Start to TTFT
items.summary_en: Reflex Engine is a GGUF-native Rust & CUDA inference engine designed for fast cold-start times on serverless GPU platforms, compiling all CUDA kernels ahead-of-time at build to eliminate runtime JIT overhead. In real-world Runpod benchmarks on an RTX A4500, Reflex reached a servable state in ~42–44 seconds versus ~52 seconds for Runpod's official vLLM worker—approximately 3.4x faster—with Reflex itself adding only ~1.6s of marginal load time. It targets single-shot, bursty workloads where per-second billing makes time-to-first-token a cost factor rather than sustained throughput.

items.title: OpenRouter 教程：提示词或模型变更后如何对 AI Agent 做回归测试
items.summary_en: OpenRouter released a tutorial on AI Agent regression testing, recommending that teams rerun a locked set of test cases against written behavior contracts whenever prompts, models, tool definitions, or retrieval configurations change. To ensure reproducibility, use concrete model slugs like `anthropic/claude-fable-5.1` rather than aliases that may resolve to newer versions. Each test case should include structural assertions on tool calls and hard invariants—such as not approving refunds over a specified dollar threshold—enforced via tools like Ori Eval, with failures in hard invariants treated as automatic release blockers.

items.title: Sarvam AI 发布从第一性原理构建 AI 智能体的入门指南
items.summary_en: Sarvam AI published a 25-minute first-principles guide to building AI agents, using ShopBot (a customer service agent for online store Kirana Express) as the贯穿example. The core thesis is that agents are simply language models running in loops with tool-calling capability, and that skills, memory, and domain knowledge are all just text placed in the context window at the right time. The guide covers system prompts, tool design, progressive skill exposure, short/long-term memory, RAG retrieval, and agent decomposition principles, ending with an end-to-end example, common error checklist, and construction checklist.

items.title: OpenRouter 教程：如何测试 AI Agent 的工具调用准确性
items.summary_en: OpenRouter published a tutorial on evaluating AI Agent tool-calling accuracy by splitting failures into two categories: wrong tool selection and incorrect parameters. It introduces three evaluation methods — a reference-free LLM judge, deterministic JSON Schema parameter checks, and trajectory comparison — along with sample Python code using the OpenRouter API and OpenAI SDK for cross-model testing. The guide emphasizes keeping test cases, scoring rules, and model configurations consistent when comparing multiple models.

A Privacy Analysis of Web and Mobile Conversational AI Agents [pdf]
items.summary: 该研究对网页和移动端对话式AI代理进行了隐私分析，发现AI代理在交互过程中存在严重的用户数据追踪风险。研究以"像蝴蝶一样轻触（提问），像追踪器一样蛰人"为隐喻，揭示了主流对话式AI代理在收集和处理用户隐私数据方面的潜在威胁。文章呼吁对AI代理的数据行为加强隐私保护和监管审查。

items.title: Show HN: InfiniHash App Store – compliance tools built end-to-end by AI agents
items.summary: InfiniHash App Store 是一个由 AI agents 端到端研究、构建并发布的合规工具应用商店，包含 AttestProof（用户访问审核）、LiveRun（供应商银行变更验证）等工具，每个应用可在5分钟内完成且无需第三方账户，最终生成审计员接受的 PDF 证据包。与现有合规方案相比，该平台免去了第三方集成依赖，采用免费开始+月付固定价格的定价模式，所有应用均由 AI agents 基于公开证据自主完成。

items.title: dream-num/univer
items.summary: Univer 是开源的 Office SDK，提供电子表格、文档、演示、数据库、看板及 PDF 处理的一体化运行时，采用 Canvas 渲染与专属公式引擎确保高性能，并支持插件架构与单一 Facade API 在浏览器与 Node.js 双端运行。目前已集成 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、OpenClaw 等 AI Agent 工具，让 AI 可生成交互式仪表板并在同一文件中协同处理数据。与现有方案相比，Univer 强调无头模式（Headless）与服务端计算能力，适合嵌入 SaaS 产品或内部工具构建可定制的生产力体验。
